Package dayplanner

Class DayPlanner

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.DayPlanner
public class DayPlanner extends Object
Orchestrates the functionality of the DayPlanner project. Lets users add and search through activities that are split into three categories: home, school, and other.

    • addNewActivity

      public void addNewActivity(String type, String title, Time startingTime, Time endingTime, String comment, String location) throws InvalidActivityException, InvalidTimeException
      Adds an activity of the requested type. Adds a new activity to the appropriate array
      Parameters:
      type - The type of the acitivity
      title - The title of the activity
      startingTime - The starting time of the activity
      endingTime - The ending time of the activity
      comment - A short description of the activity
      location - The location of the activity (if the activity is 'other')
      Throws:
      InvalidActivityException - if the activity fields are invalid
      InvalidTimeException - if an activity time is invalid

    • getActivitiesBasedOnRestrictions

      public ArrayList<Activity> getActivitiesBasedOnRestrictions(String type, String titleKeywords, Time startingTime, Time endingTime)
      Prints the activities that fits the conditions inputted by the user
      Parameters:
      type - If given, The type of the activity to search for
      titleKeywords - If given, the title keywords to search for in each activity
      startingTime - If given, the starting time of the range
      endingTime - If given, the ending time of the range
      Returns:
      activities matching all supplied restrictions
